subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “During English class, a student asked to open the window.”?
options: The students learned that music is not only something found online.
Students learned that not every disagreement needs a winner.
Every year, students in our school join a speaking contest.
Students put their homework there every morning.

本文可直接核對「Students learned that not every disagreement needs a winner.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「Every year, students in our school join a speaking contest.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
